description.zh:
按名称匹配查询类型，支持以下2种类型，默认为精确查询。

- fuzzy：模糊查询。
- exact：精确查询。
description.en:
Specifies how to match the origin pool name. The default is `exact`. Valid values:

- `fuzzy`: Performs a fuzzy search.

- `exact`: Performs an exact match.
The name of the origin pool.

description.zh:
排序，支持按ID的升序、降序，默认按ID降序，ID和创建时间正相关。

- id: 按ID降序。
- id: 按ID升序。
description.en:
Specifies how the results are sorted. By default, results are sorted by ID in descending order. To sort by ID in ascending order, set this parameter to `id`. IDs increase with creation time.

- id: Sorts by ID in descending order.

- id: Sorts by ID in ascending order.
The page number. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 页面大小，大于0的整数，最大500，超过500会置为500。
description.en: The number of entries per page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 500. If you specify a value greater than 500, the system uses 500.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. To get this ID, call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-origin-pools --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --name pool1 --match-type exact --order-by id --site-id 151538882642832 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListOriginPools --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy id --SiteId 151538882642832 --PageSize 20 --MatchType exact --PageNumber 1 --Name pool1
